name: Infantry_Updater
author: Infantry AI
description: Updates: checks the release source (GitHub Releases, public or private, or a local releases folder), downloads and verifies the new build, and installs it: the desktop MSI, the headless server archive, and the Android APK. Setting updater.source: public (default, never sends a token) or private (a read token from env INFANTRY_UPDATE_TOKEN, else keystore update-token, else the OS credential store).

config.title: Updater
config.applies: Applies to: where this install (desktop, server and the phone through this daemon) looks for new versions.

fields.label: Source (public or private)
fields.description: public never sends a token. private reads a read-only token from env INFANTRY_UPDATE_TOKEN, else the keystore secret update-token, else the OS credential store.

fields.label: Channel (production or unstable)
fields.description: production = GitHub releases; unstable = the local releases folder below.

fields.label: Check again every (hours, 0 = only at start)
